meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: solution_aTFrQkQDgvp7m17er_playbook_akqfg
title: Check Threat Intelligence for CASE Record (Button)
description: >
  Enriches observables with threat intelligence and updates the SIG record with risk scores, verdicts, and intelligence status.
actions:
  Get_Observable_Completion_Status:
    title: Get Observable Completion Status
    type: connector
    description: >
      Retrieves threat intelligence completion status and risk assessment for observables using AI SOC analysis.
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete:
    - Update_CASE_Record: {}
    publish: {}
    action: $playbook.component_aePROg2qSyYZEflT2_playbook
    inputs:
      Observable_Values:
        $:ref: $event.data.record.values.observables
    pool: $default
    testInputs: {}
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
    retryUntil:
      delay: 30000
      duration: 900000
      limit: 4
      if:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $actions.Get_Observable_Completion_Status.result.published.Enrichment_Complete
          - $:eq: true
  Update_CASE_Record:
    meta: {}
    title: Update CASE Record
    type: recordAction
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - Update_Timeline: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Updates the CASE record with threat intelligence reference IDs, verdict, classification, risk score, and completion status.
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 23e915f4-b389-4f1c-8ed2-45c30e839236
    inputs:
      applicationName: ""
      applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
      trackingId: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['tracking-id'] }"
      patchValues:
        threat-intelligence-reference:
          $:ref: $actions.Get_Observable_Completion_Status.result.published.TI_Record_Tracking_IDs
        threat-intelligence-status: Complete
        turbine-risk-score:
          $:ref: $actions.Get_Observable_Completion_Status.result.published.Turbine_Risk_Score
        intelligence-verdict: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Observable_Completion_Status.result.published.Threat_Intelligence_Verdict }'
        classification: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Observable_Completion_Status.result.published.Classification }'
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}
      restrictions:
        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
    recordActionType: patch
  Update_Timeline:
    title: Update Timeline
    type: connector
    description: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    action: $playbook.component_aXlYrqnbr1i_dcEii_playbook
    inputs:
      Tracking_ID: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['tracking-id'] }"
      Playbook_Name: Check Threat Intelligence - Manual Action Button
      Title: Check Threat Intelligence Results
      Added_By: '{ $:ref: $event.data.currentUser.username }'
      Details: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Observable_Completion_Status.result.published.Threat_Intelligence_Verdict }'
      Timestamp: "{ $:ref: $event.data.record.values['last-updated'] }"
    pool: $default
    testInputs: {}
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
triggers: {}
entrypoints:
- Get_Observable_Completion_Status
meta:
  enabled: true
namespace: $default
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish: {}
environment: {}
inputs:
  type: object
